sections.title: 03 · Success & failure
paragraphs: A motion passes only if it reaches the exact final reference timestamp without any condition below firing. All comparisons use the actual and reference states at the same time.

rows: Absolute difference between the Z components of unit gravity projected into actual and reference torso frames.
Maximum absolute world-Z error across the four designated end effectors.

notes: Any condition is sufficient. Threshold equality does not fail; a failure at the final timestamp still counts.
Height is relative to the reference, not a minimum standing height. Lying down or touching the floor is not automatically a failure.
Gravity is g = (0, 0, −1). For local-to-world rotation R, projection is Rᵀg. The tilt check compares its Z components; the threshold is not an angle.
XY / yaw alignment applies to reporting only. No additional XY, yaw, contact or keybody-distance threshold affects success.

sections.title: 04 · Rollout modes

rows: Keep running to the exact endpoint, with no reset or reference change.
Same first-failure definition; recovery does not restore success.
Last valid sample time / full duration.
Same value, frozen at the first failure.
Observed prefix, including the failing sample.

notes: The two modes require separate runs using the same checkpoint. Prefix scores are never substituted for full-motion scores.
Invalid numerical states, inference errors and truncated smoke runs cannot produce a successful full-suite result.

sections.title: 05 · Metrics

rows: Number of complete motions without failure, divided by all 40 motions.
Last valid sample time divided by full reference duration, averaged equally across motions.
Mean Euclidean position error of 14 named body origins. Average bodies and samples within each motion, then average motions equally.

paragraphs: MPBPE is reported in both rollout modes under each alignment below: six distinct views of tracking accuracy.
notes: XY + yaw: remove pelvis XY translation and the closest relative world-Z rotation. Preserve absolute height and tilt.
XY only: remove pelvis XY translation. Preserve heading, absolute height and tilt.
No alignment: compare world-frame positions directly, retaining translation and heading drift.
The same 14 metric bodies are used in every view: {metric_bodies}.
Degenerate yaw alignment is flagged and retained. Tracking accuracy should be read together with success and coverage.

sections.title: 06 · Reproduction
paragraphs: Each score links the evaluated adapter commit, core commit, checkpoint hash and per-motion evidence. The core independently recomputes failures and metrics from the recorded poses.
